description: [h1]Recipe Framework Survival[/h1]A Survival Custom Game and modder framework: bot hijack gameplay plus store / quest hooks for Blocks & Parts mods.[b]Key Features[/b][list][*]Custom menus, expanded inventory, advanced farming, and host dev tools[*]Hack Beacons / tile loaders for hijack gameplay[*]Store hooks — craftbot.json, hideout_trades.json, mininghub_trades.json via ModDatabase[*]Unlockable schematic progression (not a vault-tree editor)[*]RfsQuest API around Survival QuestManager (see MODDER_API.txt)[*]frameworkOnly flag in rfs_settings.json for baseline / framework-only mode[/list][b]Install[/b][list][*]Subscribe to ModDatabase (keep installed; do not enable as a world mod)[*]Create a new world with [b]Recipe Framework Survival[/b][*]Enable your Blocks & Parts mods[/list][b]For mod authors[/b]See AUTHOR_GUIDE.txt and MODDER_API.txt in the mod folder.[b]Author:[/b] DemonsDen126
name: Recipe Framework Survival
